Choose your mood: remove6 just the rear
window to retain shade from the sun, flip back
the upper section for a fully open roof, or
remove6 the entire top altogether. With
a spring-assisted and zipperless design,
Sunrider® allows you to become one with
the sun and stars. Crafted from heavy-duty
waterproof cloth material and available in
Black. Standard. Also available with premium
fabric that is thicker, richer in color and
easier to clean. Available in Black.

view of the trail by removing6 just four bolts,
folding the windshield down and securing it
with straps available from Mopar®.
